name: Laughing Buddha Comedy
access_note: Comedy school and producer that runs shows at multiple partner venues (Laughing Buddha classroom, NYCC UWS and others); tickets on Squarespace, schedule loads dynamically. Their own room is the 410 8th Ave classroom

name: Producers Club Theaters
access_note: Hell's Kitchen Off-Off Broadway theater rental venue; productions listed via Facebook/event producers rather than a venue calendar. Bars and lounges host some shows but no fixed weekly stand-up showcase

name: Rodney's Comedy Club
access_note: UES comedy club with nightly ticketed shows and weekly free Monday show (Madison Sinclair headlines) plus weekly showcases like Geno & Friends (Sun). Site built with detailed shows and open-mic pages

name: Brooklyn Art Haus
access_note: Williamsburg arts and events venue (theater, music, comedy, cabaret) with a free weekly comedy showcase (Malev and Friends) and a free Sunday Open Mic at 5:30pm

name: Baby Grand LES
source_label: Venue home (NYC karaoke bar with private event space)
access_note: LES karaoke bar (voted NYC's #1 karaoke). Has a calendar page but it's karaoke contests and private events, not a recurring comedy showcase

name: The Fear City Comedy Club
access_note: 60-seat dry comedy club in a former boxing gym on the LES/Chinatown border. WooCommerce-driven shows page lists upcoming dates through November. No fixed weekly showcase visible on the site

name: The Hop Shoppe
source_label: Venue home (Staten Island Stapleton bar & grill)
access_note: Staten Island Stapleton bar & restaurant; menus, beer list and reservations on the site. No public events calendar and no recurring stand-up showcase visible
note: Neighborhood confirmed Stapleton via OpenTable listing and the venue's own site. Bar/restaurant without a venue-run comedy calendar.

name: Secret Pour
access_note: Bushwick bar and lounge (GoDaddy-built site). Events page lists no upcoming events; no recurring stand-up showcase on the venue's own site
note: Neighborhood confirmed Bushwick via Yelp and Zillow. Bar hosts third-party comedy nights but none with a fixed cadence on its own calendar.

name: O'Keefe's Bar And Grill
access_note: Downtown Brooklyn bar & grill near Court St; the venue's own https page does not resolve cleanly (GoDaddy certificate mismatch), and there is no public events calendar on Facebook either. Punching Bag Comedy runs its weekly Wednesday showcase here (listed separately as a venue)
note: 45-year Brooklyn Heights bar; Yelp calls the area Brooklyn Heights. Downtown Brooklyn kept in the registry for consistency. Venue has no https site of its own.

name: Liffy II Bar
source_label: No venue-owned website; programming visible only on Facebook and Instagram
access_note: Inwood whiskey bar on Broadway. No own site (liffybar.com is a GoDaddy parked domain). Live D&D nights and irregular comedy nights (e.g. Have a Good Mic) promoted via Facebook only
note: Neighborhood Inwood confirmed via Instagram bio and the venue's posted signage. No fixed weekly stand-up showcase on a venue-controlled page.

name: The Local NY
source_label: Venue home (LIC hostel/bar; no dedicated comedy calendar)
access_note: Long Island City hostel/cafe/bar hybrid. The site covers stays and a sparse events archive from 2016-2018; comedy nights run on Instagram only with no fixed weekly schedule on the venue's own pages
note: Comedy nights exist (Facebook and Instagram posts about a Wednesday night mic) but with no published weekly cadence on the venue's own site.

name: The PIT
source_label: Peoples Improv Theater home and calendar
access_note: Peoples Improv Theater (the PIT Loft, 2nd floor at 154 W 29th St). Improv-first theater with classes, jams and a handful of stand-up events including the Saturday Ladies Stand-Up Open Mic. No fixed weekly paid stand-up showcase; held out of recurring.json for that reason
note: Neighborhood kept as Chelsea to match Yelp (PIT Loft straddles Chelsea and Midtown West).

name: Sesh Comedy
source_label: SESH showcases page (Friday and Saturday Night SESH Showcase)
access_note: BYOB comedy room on the LES / Chinatown border. Weekly Friday and Saturday Night SESH Showcases (70-minute showcases, $7 fee) plus occasional headline shows. Showcase page lists dates through October 2026
note: Address on the venue's own site is 55 Chrystie St; neighborhood LES per the location page.

name: Comedy In Harlem
access_note: Harlem comedy club (around 147th St and St Nicholas Ave). Weekly Funny Lines Open Mic Mondays 5:30pm, Paid by the Bell Tuesdays, Ladies Night Mondays, Flash Feature Wednesdays and more, listed through December 2026
note: Neighborhood Harlem confirmed via the venue's own pages and Yelp.

name: Pine Box Rock Shop
source_label: Pine Box Rock Shop event calendar
access_note: Bushwick (the venue's own homepage says 'East Williamsburg/Bushwick, just steps from the Morgan Ave L') bar in a former casket factory. Multiple recurring stand-up mics: Deadass (every Friday 6pm, free), CHAMPS (every Wednesday), Pillow Fight, Jeans & A Nice Top, JesterMAXXING, plus Miércoles con Mateo Wednesdays and the monthly Sketch Mic NYC on the last Tuesday
note: Registry keeps Bushwick; the venue labels the area East Williamsburg/Bushwick on its site.

name: Echo Bravo
source_label: Bravo Bar Party group site (Echo Bravo is one of three bars)
access_note: Bushwick sports bar in the Bushwick Collective; the Bravo Bar Party group site has no venue-specific comedy calendar. Site focuses on the wing menu, happy hour and reservations. No recurring stand-up showcase on the venue's own pages
note: Neighborhood Bushwick confirmed via NYC Tourism and Yelp.

name: BK Made Comedy
access_note: BYOB Bushwick comedy club (founded 2025 by George Diaz). Comedy Tonight nightly showcase Mondays-Thursdays at 8pm ($5), Sharp Tongue Comedy first Thursday ($15), Friday and Saturday 8pm shows ($15). Free pizza Fri/Sat
note: Neighborhood Bushwick confirmed via Zillow and Homes.com.

name: Freddy's Bar
access_note: South Slope bar at 627 5th Ave (between 17th and 18th Sts). Weekly Comedy Open Mic (The Fun Mic — Alex's Comedy Open Mic) Mondays and Wednesdays at 7pm; New Material Night 1st Wednesdays at 9:30pm; Late Night Laughs after Thursday burlesque; monthly storytelling 3rd Mondays
note: Neighborhood South Slope confirmed via Yelp and the venue's own pages.
